summary: Phase 1 Silent Voice UI-shell tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 pytest cases pass against public preview URL. Frontend: 39/39 Playwright assertions pass across landing, onboarding modal, nav, /live, /reverse, /practice, /transcripts, /settings, /about, /auth. Design is on-brief (Fraunces headlines, copper CTA, dark editorial). Animated landmark SVG overlay renders on landing + live. Reverse translate returns expected gloss [TODAY, YOU, HOW]. Live clear-btn empties transcript list. Auth signup toggle reveals Name field. No console errors detected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated FastAPI @app.on_event('shutdown'); prefer lifespan handlers (non-blocking, informational).
REVERSE_EXAMPLES dictionary uses lowercase-key lookup which correctly handles case; DROP set uses uppercase — logic is consistent since words are uppercased before filter. OK.
CORS is wide-open (*) with allow_credentials=True — acceptable for Phase 1 mock but should be tightened before prod.
seed_data_creation: None — all endpoints return static mock data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Phase 1 features validated. Auth submit is intentionally non-functional (preventDefault). Backend /api/status writes to Mongo (not part of Phase 1 spec, not asserted). If phase 2 wires MediaPipe/WebSocket, add real-time frame streaming tests.
